title: Warranty Part Repair Hold at Payoff
content:
# Warranty Part Repair Hold at Payoff

Window Replacement Contracts — hold at payoff while warranty parts are awaited under the household's Warranty Coverage registrations.

**Rule.** The warranty repair hold comes from the warranty service visits on the household's registrations: when the units left with a part on order, less the units later recorded as repaired, come to two or more, the multi-unit warranty hold of $400 is held; when they come to one, the single-unit warranty hold of $200 is held; otherwise nothing is held.

The visits read are the warranty service visits on every registration of the household. The hold is taken from the job charges collected at payoff.

| Units with a part on order, less units recorded as repaired | Warranty repair hold |
|---|---|
| 0 or fewer | Nothing |
| 1 | $200 |
| 2 or more | $400 |

## Hypothetical case

A service visit left 3 units with a part on order and a later visit recorded 2 units repaired: 1 unit is awaited, so $200 is held.
